_comment: Stage 3 structuring (TAGGING_SPEC_v0.5.md sec. 6) for Milestone 1's 10-record eligibility sample (reports/eligibility_criteria_sample.md). Done by hand by Claude in the session that built this pipeline - no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is configured in this sandbox for a live call. Tier is assigned relative to the Milestone 1/5 test persona (30F, no prior surgery, wants future fertility, moderate anemia, BMI 20) - see reports/milestone_7_status.md for the full reasoning, including two cases flagged as structurally harder than the spec's worked example: a compound OR criterion (NCT02288130) and an investigator-discretion catch-all (NCT01369758).

NCT03270605.verbatim: Performed another surgical procedure at CS other than myomectomy.
NCT03270605.concept: concurrent surgical procedure at index C-section

NCT03411980.verbatim: Any relevant disease within 4 weeks prior to study drug administration including infections and acute gastrointestinal diseases (vomiting, diarrhea, constipation) requiring medical treatment.

Severe cerebrovascular or cardiac disorders less than 6 months prior to study drug administration, e.g. stroke, myocardial infarction, unstable angina pectoris, percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty or coronary artery bypass graft, congestive heart failure of Grade III or IV according to New York Heart Association, or arrhythmia requiring antiarrhythmic treatment.
Malignancy diagnosed or treated within the past 5 years. This does not include adequately treated basal cell carcinoma or localized squamous cell carcinoma of the skin.
Acute renal failure or acute nephritis within the past 2 years.
Use of CYP3A4 inducers from 2 weeks before study drug administration until last day of blood sampling for PK after study drug administration, including grapefruits.
Insufficiently controlled diabetes mellitus with fasting blood glucose \>220 mg/dL or HbA1c \>10%.

NCT03550703.verbatim: other gynecological diseases not related to myoma hysterectomy

NCT01504308.verbatim: Other Pelvic Disease (Other mass, endometriosis, ovarian tumor, acute pelvic disease, significant adenomyosis)
Significant systemic disease even if controlled

NCT01504308.qualifier: moderate (user's term, unresolved against record's numeric threshold)

NCT01504308.verbatim: Extensive scarring along anterior lower abdominal wall (\>50% of area)
Surgical clips in the potential path of the HIFU beam
MRI contrast agent contraindicated (including renal insufficiency)
Calcifications around or throughout uterine tissues that may affect treatment
Highly perfused or brighter than myometrium in T2-weighted MRI (according to the T2 contrast obtained using the Philips MR-HIFU MR protocol) fibroids
Fibroids not quantifiable on MRI (e.g. multi-fibroid cases where volume measurements are not feasible)
Menses lasting \> 7 days or intermenstrual bleeding (patient can be included if there is endometrial biopsy within 6 months to exclude malignancy)
Patient is currently on hormonal medication for fibroids or has a hormonal medication history as described below:
1-month Lupron dose or equivalent: less than 1 month prior to MBL measurement or
3-month Lupron dose or equivalent: less than 3 months prior to MBL measurement or
Depo Provera or equivalent: less than 6 months prior to MBL measurement

NCT06430320.verbatim: Individuals who were not consented into the original COMPARE-UF or ULTRA study
Individuals who did not have a uterine-sparing fibroid treatment at enrollment in COMPARE-UF or ULTRA study

NCT01369758.verbatim: Subject has an Intrauterine Device (IUD) at the time of the procedure. A subject may be enrolled in the study if the IUD is removed prior to the treatment procedure
Subject is taking an anticoagulant or antiplatelet medication other than low dose aspirin
Active pelvic inflammatory disease or pelvic/vaginal infection
Subject has a known or suspected coagulopathy or bleeding disorder
Subject has a history of disease which increases the risk for fluid overload (i.e. significant cardiac, hepatic, or renal dysfunction)
Subject has other co-morbid condition(s) that, in the opinion of the Investigator, could limit the subject's ability to participate in the study or impact the scientific integrity of the study
NCT01369758.qualifier: in the opinion of the Investigator (inherently subjective, never resolvable)

NCT03211481.verbatim: insufficient knowledge and experience with fibroid patient population or interventions to reduce major blood loss at surgery
NCT03211481.concept: clinician qualification (this is a provider-facing study, not patient-facing)

NCT03211481.verbatim: insufficient time or not willing to participate
Not a member from academic and/or community hospital

NCT02288130.verbatim: any type 0-2 fibroids smaller than 5 cm
more than 2 type 3-6 fibroids \> 5 cm that need to be removed (except type 7 fibroids of any size)
use of any hormonal agents and not willing to discontinue their use
Use of NSAIDs impacting bleeding before surgery
Contraindication to laparoscopy procedure or causes of complications (multiple laparotomies, frozen pelvis, severe endometriosis)
NCT02288130.concept: compound: prior-surgery history (multiple laparotomies) OR unrelated conditions (frozen pelvis, severe endometriosis)
NCT02288130.qualifier: compound OR criterion - prior-surgery part is addressed, other disjuncts are not, so the whole criterion can't be resolved from one answer

NCT02288130.verbatim: allergy to leuprolide acetate/comparable nonapeptides or Ulipristal

NCT03169478.concept: menopausal status (age-correlated but not identical to the age field already evaluated in Tier A/Milestone 5 - not inferred from age here)
